Occurrences.Kwic: 胡來漢去。死中得活。活中得死。且道到這裏。又作麼
Occurrences.ClaimText: 胡來漢去。死中得活。活中得死。且道到這裏。又作麼
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T48/T48n2003.xml). Blue Cliff Record by Chan Master Yuanwu Foguo: full-section review assigns the exact headword clause to Fushan Fayuan.

Senses.Explanation: The saying sequence tests obtaining death within life and life within death; each answer turns on reversing the expected relation between the two states. The paired live/dead sequence controls the interpretation rather than a literal biological event.
